column1: # p423, 2026-10-24 — the MCP-over-SIS capability leg, graded first-hand.
# Channel: `git ls-remote` for refs + raw.githubusercontent.com/<slug>/<SHA>/<path> for
# payloads (Amendment 11.1: read the grant at the SHA, never at a ref).  Bytes by the FILE
# channel (`curl -o file; wc -c < file`); digest = first 12 hex of sha256, this base's
# canonical pair.  Calibration: `Mattlo0546/canvas-mcp` LICENSE at SHA b6c26ba reproduced
# `1 067` B / `13c8ad755224` exactly, so the instrument is re-calibrated on this host (T106).
# api.github.com and github.com HTML: 403 on this egress allowlist (p413/p415/p422), so star
# counts are NOT in this table — p415 settled that they are derivable, not readable here.
# Ladder: this base's canonical 16-path list including `LICENSE.TXT` (T110 / Amendment 11.2).
# 🔴 THE FINDING: `tixuz/openemis-mcp` is published as MIT by its npm registry metadata AND
# by its own in-repo manifest, and its only grant payload is Business Source License 1.1 —
# a source-available licence that is not open source.  The conflict is not a stale directory
# entry: it ships INSIDE the published tarball, byte-identical to the repo payload.
